text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've come to observe a race, and what a
race it is!
Running ahead of the pack is a
certain pair of
Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Paaalmeeer! C'mon, bestie, let's gooo!
We gotta
show this crowd what we're
made of!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Bet! Let's do this, bestie!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daitaku Helios and Mejiro Palmer banter
as they
fight for first place with grins on
their faces. They
soon close in on the
final stretch, and...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Haha... I didn't even make it on the
scoreboard...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you did great out there! Don't be
sad. Sure
we got scooched off the
scoreboard, buuut...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
It's a great time for a selfie! Hang on, I'll
be right
back with my phone!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Uh, hmm... I'm not really feeling it right
now.
Gimme a sec to get my face ready!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, whoa! What's up? Your
face is
always on point!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: C'mon, this is the moment! You're the moment!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I know you're still shook from the race
results,
and honestly, mood. That was a
major L. Like,
XXL.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
But that's exactly why we gotta turn
things
around! We gotta smile and fake
it till we make it!
Reach for the stars and
stuff, amirite? ☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
We can't call ourselves the Runaway
Besties if we
drop from the front just
'cause our vibes are off!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
'Sides, if we snap a pic now, we can post
a
before-and-after later to show what we
look like
when we win!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
We can't wait to see your victory selfie!
You can
do it, Runaway Besties!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, squad! It's gonna be so fire!
Okay, let me
hear you screeeam!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Who's gonna win the next race?!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: The Runaway Besties!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Who's gonna steal the spotlight at the
concert?!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: The Runaway Bestiiiies!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Hahaha! Now that's what I call
cheering.
Really got my vibes in order.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
All right! No time to mope! We're going
full steam
ahead! Thanks for your
support, fam!

text_block_list.name: Palmer's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Man, Helios, you're so awesome! I'm
more of a
Palmer fan myself, but you've
got me smiling too!

text_block_list.name: Helios's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Right?! Helios's smile is literally so
infectious! I
can't even look at her
without grinning myself!
She's the best!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, no cap?! Everyone's seriously
smiling up a
storm here! All right, get in,
guys, we need a selfie
with the squad!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the way home, I come across Daitaku
Helios
and Mejiro Palmer, fresh from
hyping up the
stands.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... So my smile makes them happy,
huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Oh, you mean what our fans said before?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Yep! So I was thinking, but...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: It'd be high-key awesome if we could cheer even more people up with our smiles! Like, what if we turned up the vibes for the whole country, y'know? ☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
We could call it... Operation: Get Japan
Hyped!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! That sounds like a plan for sure!
But, uh,
how's it gonna work?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, good question. I guess I just gotta
find a
way to get the whole country in a
party mood... or
something.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey! You're a trainer, right? Got
some advice
or somethin'?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Oh. Em. Gee! That's so galaxy-brained!
choice_data_list: 今のままで充分だと思う！
choice_data_list_en: Maybe try to boost your profile?
I think you're plenty fine just as you are!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
If we're talking about getting people to
take
notice, there's only one way to do
it! And that's
to go viral and ride that
wave of attention!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Sheesh, now I'm super hyped! What should I do? Hey, Trainer, you can be my producer, okay?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, this whole idea was, like, your
brainchild,
so you get the honors.
Anyway, let's do this! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sucked in by her whirlwind of
enthusiasm, I end
up becoming her
producer for Operation: Get
Japan
Hyped. I have no idea how this is going
to
work out...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Sooo... what are you gonna do?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
No clue. But I've got my partner and my
producer
here, so let's go, go, go! It's
time to take the
world by storm!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I have no idea how I got appointed as
her
producer, but first things first—I
have to catch up
with Daitaku Helios!
choice_data_list: プロデューサーって……俺！？
プロデューサーって……私！？

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: What?! I shouldn't do anything different? I know you're my producer and all, but this ain't it, chief!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I calm her down by explaining that her
smile's so
genuine that just by racing like
normal, she'll
make the spectators
happy.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ooh... Okay, it def hits different when
you say it
that way!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'll keep serving up smiles on
the track,
then! ☆ Shout-out for the tip,
Trainer!
